tei:div.tei:p: 'phags pa thugs rje chen po ngan song rang grol gyi dbang bskur ba'i las rim sgrigs chags lags/ 470) oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i zla shel dri med gzugs// rab dwangs mos pa'i rgya mtshor rnam bkra mgon po mchog /gang gi zhabs pad spyi bor bkod de gdul bya'i tshogs// smin byed bdud rtsi'i zil mngar sbyin 'dir gus brten 'tshal/ 'dir 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po ngan song rang grol gyis chos skor rig 'dzin chen po u rgyan las 'phro gling pa'i gter ma'i dbang bskur gyi las rim rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'dod pa bya tshul/ gzhung gi dgongs don phyag bzhes su gtan la phab ste ston pa la gnyis/ sngon du bya ba'i las rim dang*/ dngos gzhi dbang gi las rim gnyis las dang po la/ 'di lta bu'i dbang bskur 471) byed pa'i slob dpon ni spyir mdo rgyud rnams las ji ltar gsungs pa'i bla ma'i mtshan nyid rnams tshang ba las kyang lhag par byang chub kyi sems rin po che rang 'dod kyi dri mas ma gos pa dang ldan pas thugs rje chen po'i bskyed rdzogs la drod rtags cung zad thob pa zhig gal che zhing*/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid ni dad gus dam tshig dang ldan na khyim pa pho mo lta bu yang skabs 'dir snod du rung ste/ thugs rje chen po'i gdul bya ni lhag bsam dang snying rje byang sems kho nas khyad par du byas pa'i phyir ro/ gnas kyi mtshan nyid kyang spyir ni dbang gzhung nyid nas gsungs pa ltar las/ gtso bor ni dam med snod min gyi dben zhing gtsang la yid dang mthun pa nyid gal che ba dang*/ gnas der 472) gza' skar dus ches bzang por/ sa'i cho ga dang stegs bu bzhengs nas ye shes dang las kyi thig gdab pa sogs ni gzhung nas gsal bar gsungs pas 'dir bskyar bzlos su ma dgos la/ dkyil 'khor bzhengs thabs dngos ni 'di nyid kyi sgrub pa phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid tha dad kyi dbang so so la rang rang gi lugs bzhin bri dgos mod kyi/

'dir ni re zhig phyi sgrub kho na'i dbang du byas te rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor sgo 'khyams rta babs 'khor yug sogs thams cad spyi mthun las/ lte ba dkar po'i mthar pad+ma 'dab bzhi phyogs mdog mthing ser dmar ljang dang*/ de rgyab 'dab ma bcu gnyis mdzes tshon mu 'khyud 'od zer lnga ldan gyis bskor bar bri/ gal te rdul tshon dang ras bris sogs ma 'byor na 'bras dkar gyi tshom bu dgos pa'i grangs kyang 'di dang mtshungs par dbus su lnga dang*/ mtha' skor du bcu gnyis/ de mthar phyogs bzhir sgo bzhi dang bar 'khyams thub pa drug dang sangs rgyas stong gi mtshon byed dang bcas par gang shong tsam 'god/ dbang rdzas ni dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su lding khri'i khar dngul la sogs pa'i bum pa dkar po 473) mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la dar dkar gyi mgul mchings dang gzungs thag dkar po can/ kha rgyan gyi khrod du seng ldeng phur bu sor bzhi pa dpal rta mgrin gyi bar chad bsrung bar dmigs la bzhugs su gsol zhing*/ bum nang du gangs chu gtsang ma la ba dkar mo'i 'o ma dang bam rdzas nyer lnga btab pas bum pa'i sum gnyis bkang ste lding khri'i dbus su bshams/ de'i shar du gtso 'khor gyi sku rten dang me tog cod paṇa/ lhor dbu rgyan rigs lnga/ nub tu thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i kha gcod me long sin+dhu ras byugs pa la chos 'byung bris pa'i steng du gsang dbang gi rdzas byang sems dkar dmar cu gang gur gum ka ra bu ram rnams sbyar ba'i ril bu slob ma'i grangs mnyam dang*/ byang du rdo rje dril bu/ mtshams rnams su yi ge drug ma'i 'bru tha dad bris pa'i tsak+ka li dang shel 'phreng*/ chos dbyug sba dkar tshigs gsum/ rjes gnang gi yo byad gdugs dang dung dkar/ 'khor lo/ spyi blug chos bka' de nyid kyi po ti sogs bzhag shar sgor las bum mgul mchings dmar po can gyi kha rgyan 474) dpal rga mgrin gyi sku'am hrīḥdamar bris pa'i bum nang du dri bzang gi chu la yungs dkar btab pas bkang la bshams zhing*/

dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs gyi gtor ma dang*// rdo rje de mo sogs bka' srung gi sman rag mchod pa sna lnga rgyas par bsham pas mdzes shing bag dro bar bya/ sgrub pa chen po'i khog 'bubs lta bu la ni dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan gong du phyogs bzhir me long bzhi dang mda' dar bzhi/ mtshams bzhir ral gri bzhi dang phur pa dar gyi cod paṇa bzhi/ bar thams cad du tshon skud sna lnga'i drwa ba rim brel tshul phyag bzhes mthong rgyud ltar dang*/ gzhan yang sa rgyan gnam rgyan bris sku mchod rdzas spyan gzigs rol cha sogs rten 'brel gyi yo byad mtha' dag 'dzoms par bya ba ni/ lha tshogs kyi thugs dam skongs shing gdul bya'i rgyud la ye shes ngang gi 'jug par 'gyur ba'i thabs gnad kyi rten 'brel zab mo'o/ de nas slob dpon nyid khri la 'khod nas thog mar skyabs sems yan lag bdun sogs tshogs bsags dang*/ sngon gtor bgegs bskrad srung 'khor rnams rgyas bsdus gang rigs bya/ 475) dngos gzhi bdag skyed las gzhung bsrang la/ de yang spro na bdag mdun bum gsum so so'i skyed chog spyan 'dren mchod bstod rim can dang*/ bsdu na thams cad dus gcig tu gsal zhing spyan 'dren mchod bstod kyang chab gcig par byas pas 'grub la/ lha bskyed tshul yang phyi nang gsang ba sogs sgom sgrub byed pa'i tshe na'ang gzhung bzhin bskyed cing de dang mthun pa'i bzlas pa yang bya/ las bum du ni rta mgrin dpa' bo gcig bskyed pa bzlas dang*/ rig pa'i dbang lnga'i rdzas so so la yang thugs rje chen po rigs lnga'i bskyed rim dang*/ bdud rtsi ril bu la oṃ āḥhūm̐ hra 'i'i bzlas pa dang*/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi la a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ zhes brgya phrag re bzla zhing*/ lha tshogs yab yum bde sbyor mdzad pa'i byang sems kyi rang bzhin du dmigs par bya'o/ 'dzab kyi dgongs pa dngos ni phyi sgrub nyid nas gsungs pa ltar snang srid gzhir bzhengs kyi bzlas tshul kho na'i ngang nas gzungs ring dang yig 'bru ci 'grub la 'bad cing*/

lha rnams kyi thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas 476) pa'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad mchod nas byin rlabs dngos grub tshur 'dus pa bdag mdun gyi gnas gsum du thim pa dang*/ yang bdag mdun gyi 'od zer khams gsum sems can la phog pas sdig sgrib ma lus sbyang zhing*/ thams cad thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur nas stong gsum kun sngags sgras 'ur dir du gyur par mos te bzlas pa bya/ thun mtshams su mchod bstod chogs pa dang gtor ma phul nas gsol ba gdab/ bka' srung la yang gtor mas mnyes par bya ba ste/ de ltar bdag mdun thams cad byin rlabs nus ldan du bsgrubs nas/ mthar bla ma nyid dkyil 'khor la dbang blang ba rgyas par slob bu la ji ltar bskur ba bzhin slang bar spro na/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las de 'dra ba'i sprul ba zhig 'phros pas dbang bskur gyi bya ba mdzad par dmigs nas dbang rgyas par len pa'am/ slob dpon dbang po rab gyi dbang du byas te spros pa nyer bsdud ni/ mdun bskyed kyi gnas gsum gyi 'od zer bdag la bstim pa tsam gyis 'gyur med sku/ 'gag med gsung*/ 'khrul med thugs kyi byin rlabs nus pa thams cad bdag la thim ste mkhyen rtogs yon tan mngon 477) gyur du dpa' gdengs bskyed la/ 'khor 'das mnyam nyid chen por la zlo ba ni dbang gi mchog rab phul du gyur pa ste/ 'on te tshul 'di blo yul du mi shong pa'i slob dpon dag gis ni gong du smos pa'i spros bcas kyi bdag 'jug blang ba nyid la nan tan tu bya ba gces so/ de nas slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi las rim dngos gzhi nyid ston pa la/ thog mar slob ma ji tsam yod pa rnams la phyi rol du las slob kyi las bum gyi bum pa 'khyer nas khrus byed du gzhug de nas nang du khrid de rdo rje slob dpon gyis bden stobs brjod cing thun gyis brab la rol mo drag sngags ting nge 'dzin dang bcas te bgegs bskrad/

gus phyag byas nas gral du 'khod cing maṇ+ḍal rgyas par phul ba'i rjes su/ slob dpon gyis chos 'di ltar 'chad par bya'o/ e ma/ nga ni thabs kyi ded dpon mkhan// 'khor ba'i chu bo mtha' med las// srid gsum sgrol bar dam bcas kyi// thar ba 'dod gang las 'dir shog /nga ni thugs rje'i spyan ras mkhan/ 478)/'khor ba'i dgra dpung 'jigs chen las// thams cad skyobs par dam bcas kyi// 'jigs dang bral 'dod lam 'dir shog /nga ni yid bzhin nor bu ste// gang zhig dngos grub 'dod pa rnams// re ba skong bar dam bcas kyi// lhun gyis grub 'dod lam 'dir shog mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba nam mkha'i gar khyab kyi 'jig rten rab 'byams dpag gis mi lang ba'i sems can ji snyed pa de thams cad ni 'khor ba thog med nas da lta phan gyi drin can pha mar ma gyur pa ni gang yang med la/ pha mar gyur pa de dag gi ngang tshul ni ma rig pa'i mun pa chen pos ni 'thums/ ngan song gi g.yang sa 'jigs par ni lhung*/ las nyon gyi rba klong drag por ni chud/ sdug bsngal gyi gcong chen dam pos ni mnar bas bde ba'i go skabs su gyur pa ni se gol gyi yun tsam zhig kyang ma mchis rung*/ da dung sdug bsngal la sdug bsngal du mi shes par smyon pa btsan dug za ba ltar rang gis rang phung bsgrub pa'i rgyu dang thabs mi dge sdig pa'i las 'ba' zhig la sus thob tu byed pa'i pha ma sems can 'di rnams la ci phan ci drag gi snying rje gsha' ma zhig bskyed dgos/ de ltar bskyed nas sems la phan pa sgrub par byed pa la yang rang nyid la de'i nus pa yod pa cazhag dgos kyi/ rang la nus stobs ci yang med par gzhan la phan 'dogs par rtsom yang chu khyer ra mda' skam la rgyugs pa'i dpe don du zad pas/ des na khyed rang rnams mkha' mnyam pha ma sems can gyi don mchog bla na med pa phan pa dang bde ba dam pa bsgrub pa'i slad du/

chos kyi mchog theg chen gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs/ lam gyi mchog smin grol zab mo nyams su len/ lha'i mchog thugs rje chen po yi dam du bzung nas mkha' khyab 'gro ba thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang la 'god par 480)bgyi'o snyam pa'i thugs bskyed la gnas pas gsan par mdzod/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po de nyid kyi che ba'i yon tan ji lta bu zhe na/ spyir sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i che ba'i yon tan ni rang cag so so skye bos mthong zhing rtogs par yang mi nus na tshad 'dzin par ci zhig smra nus la/ khyad par 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rnam par thar ba ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis rdo rje'i ljags kyis bskal pa brgyar yang brjod par mi lang ba gsungs na/ 'o skol tshur mthong gis blos de'i ba spu'i khung bu gcig gi yon tan gyi tshad kyang ci zhig rtogs par nus te bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos nyid yin mod kyi/ 'on te 'di skabs su rang cag rnams la bka' drin mdzad tshul che long tsam zhig brjod na/ 'phags mchog thugs rje'i bdag po de nyid ye thog dang po nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub 481)pa'i byang chub kyi 'bras bu mngon du mdzad kyang gdul bya'i don du sa bcu'i byang sems kyi tshul du mgon po 'od dpag med kyi thugs rje'i 'od zer las sprul te bde ba can gyi zhing khams lho nub 'o ma can gyi mtsho'i me tog pad+ma'i snying po las sku bltams shing*/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po mchog gi sras kyi skal bar spyan drangs te bzhugs nas gdul bya rnams byang chub lam la bkod/ de bzhin bshegs pa 'od dpag tu med pa'i spyan sngar bla na med pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed de ji srid 'khor ba gtan stongs su ma gyur gyi bar de srid nam du'ang 'khor ba'i soms can re re'i mdun du yang gang 'dul gyi sprul ba dang phrin las rgyun mi gcod par dam bcas te/

482) gal te rang nyid zhi bde'i bsam pa rdul cha phra mo tsam skyes par gyur na bdag gi mgo bo a rja ka'i rdog po ltar tshal ba bcur 'gas shing*/ lus kyang dum bu stong du bye bar gyur cig ces dmod bor te sems can gyi don mdzad nas 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho dong nas sprugs thengs lan drug mdzad kyang las ngan gyi sems can nyung du cung zad kyang ma song bar gzigs pa na thugs ngal zhing skyo ba'i rnam pa phra mo zhig shar ma thag sngar gyi dmod pa'i mthus dbu tshal ba bcu dang sku lus dum bu stong du 'thor bar gyur pa sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pas skad cig de nyid la dbu'i tshal ba rnams zhi rgyas dbang drag gi zhal bcu dang*/ sku lus dum bu rnams thugs rje'i phyag stong du byin gyis rlobs shing*/ nam du yang sems can gyi don la skyo dub mi mdzad par bka' stsal zhing dbugs phyungs/ 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar sngon gnyis kyis kyang 'gro don gyi grogs bgyi bar zhal gyis bzhes/ 'od dpag med nyid 'phags pa'i dbu bcu'i rtse mor 483) rigs kyi bdag por 'bral ba med par bzhugs par bstan zhing slar yang 'phags pa nyid kyang thugs bskyed kyi stobs dang go cha cher bzhes nas sangs rgyas bye ba khrag brgyad khri bzhi stong gi spyan sngar 'gro ba'i don du smon lam rlabs po brgya rtsa brgyad btab cing dam bcas/ sangs rgyas de dag thams cad kyis kyang thugs rje byin rlabs kyi nus pa rmad du byung ba'i 'gro ba'i don spyod par dbang bskur zhing mnga' gsol te/ 'phags pa'i phyag stong las 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po stong du sprul nas gdul bya rnams la mngon mtho'i bde dge stsol zhing*/ phyag re re'i mthil du ye shes kyi spyan stong las skal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong du sprul bas mngon mtho las nges legs byang chub tu spor bar mdzad pa sogs mdzad phrin nam mkha' rab 'byams kyi pha mthar son pa'i tshad ni su zhig gis 'dzin/

484) stong gsum bye ba phrag brgyar ma dag rigs drug gi gnas rnams su yang 'gro 'dul gyi thub chen drug sogs gdul bya'i skal snod tha dad la gdul byed kyi sprul bsgyur gang mtshams pa'i sku dang thabs dang mdzad phrin rgya mtsho srid mtha' ji snyed pa'i yun gnas de snyed du thugs rje mi zad pa'i rlabs kyis khyab pa ni rtag pa rgyun gyi phrin las yin mod kyi/ de las khyad par du 'o skol bod yul mtha' 'khob gangs can gyi 'gro la lhag par brtse bas gzigs tshul yang*/ sngon thub pa chen po nyid sku mya ngan las 'da' tshul ston par mdzad la nye ba'i tshe/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi ched du gsol ba btab ste/ rgyal ba nyid re shig 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i gdul bar bya ba'i yul dang mdzad pa mtha' dag rdzogs pa de ltar lags na/ byang phyogs kha ba can gyi rgyal khams ni 'dre srin 485) gdug pas dbang byas shing nyid kyis zhabs kyis ma bcags zhal gyis ma gzigs chos kyi ma brtul lags kyi/ gdul zhing de dag brtse bas 'thul bar ma mdzad kyi bar du sku mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol zhes zhabs kyi pad+mo la gtsug gi cod paṇa btud de gsol ba las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgo nas 'od zer gser gyi kha dog lta bu spros te byang phyogs kha ba can gyi yul khams 'di dag thams cad khyab cing bka' stsal ba/ rigs kyi bu legs so legs so khyod kyis ji ltar gsol ba btab pa ltar yul khams de bdag gis byin gyis rlabs zin gyi/ 'on kyang zhing de'i 'dul 486) skal du gyur pa ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang ldan pa khyod nyid kho nas 'dul bar 'gyur te/ ci'i phyir na 'od dpag tu med pa la sogs bdag cag de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba phrag brgyad khri bzhi stong ma lus pa'i thugs rje dang nus pa khyod la spungs par mdzad pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ khyod kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa rgya chen pos dam bcas shing bden tshig smon lam rlabs po che'i mthu nus kyis/

rgyal ba sras bcas gang gis kyang ma 'thul ba'i mtha' 'khob kyi 'gro ba de dag khyod kyis 'thul bar 'gyur la/ bdag gi thugs rje las sprul pa'i rdzus skyes pad+ma'i rigs 'chang tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin zhig gis kyang khyod kyi phrin las rgya cher sgrub par 'gyur ro/ zhes sogs lung bstan rjes su gnang bar mdzad pa bzhin/ 'phags pas kyang bod yul kha ba can gyi ljongs 487)'di gdul bya'i zhing du bdag gir mdzad de/ dang por 'phags pa yab yum gyi sprul pa spre'u dang brag srin gnyis kyis mi'i sa bon bskrun zhing theg chen gsang sngags kyi snod dang rigs su nges par mdzad/ bar du skye 'gro'i 'dod dgu 'byung phyir 'bru sna lnga'i lo thog rin chen lnga'i gter khung*/ rtsi bcud sman gyi rnam grangs dang*/ sa rdo chu shing yan chod kyi dgos pa dgu tshang zhing 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i yul du byin gyis brlabs nas/ phyogs mtha' bzhi'i longs spyod kyi nor sna mtha' dag kyang bod du 'du ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs te dbul 'phong gi sdug bsngal bsal/ mthar mi yul gyi gzhi things tshe sprul pa'i rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung ste/ gnam la khri bdun/ sa la legs drug chu la sde brgyad/ logs la btsan lnga*/ bar gyi steng gnyis la sogs su grags pa'i sprul 488)pa'i rgyal rgyud mu tig gi 'phreng ba lta bu byon pa rnams kyis bod yul gyi blun rmongs byol song lta bu rnams la ma bskyed pa'i yum dang ma 'dris pa'i bshes su gyur te/ blang dor gyi blo mig phyes shing mgon med kyi mgon du gyur de thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi bka' drin 'ba' zhig yin la/ de nas rim gyis bod kyi sems can rnams chos kyi 'dul ba'i skal ba can du gyur la nye ba na/ sprul pa'i rgyal po tho tho ri'i skabs su thugs rje gnyan po gsang bar grags pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten ngo mtshar can rnams 'phags pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha'i lam nas rgyal po'i sku mkhar gyi rtser babs pa'i byin rlabs las dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes/

de nas gdung rabs lnga na bod kyi gdul bya'i bsod nams kyi rdzing bu yongs su gang ba'i skal ngor/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang nyid 489)sprul pa'i chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku mtshan gyi me tog dang dpe byad kyi 'bras bu 'dzoms pa'i dbu'i gtsug tu rigs bdag 'od dpag med dang bcas pa'i ngo mtshar gzugs sku'i bkod pa mngon sum du bstan nas/ mtha' 'khob kyi gdul bya rnams la dang por dge ba bcu'i khrims btsugs te sgo gsum bag yod du bsgrub cing ngo mtshar yi ge'i rgyun spel/ bar du mi dang mi ma yin thams cad dbang du bsdus shing bran du bkol nas rgyal po nyid sku lus kyi sprul pa lnga stong sprul pas bzo bo dang lag dpon mdzad de/ khra 'brug ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtso byas/ stod mang yul byams pa sprin nas smad yongs rdzogs rab dga'i lha khang yan gtsug lag khang chen brgya dang rtsa brgyad kyis bod srin mo gan rgyal du gnas pa 'dra ba'i sa dgra ngan pa thams cad mnan nas 490)bkra shis shing byin chags pa bstan pa'i dam chos 'byung ba'i yul du mdzad de 'gro ba'i bsod nams tshogs chen gyi zhing sa bla med du bsgrub cing*/ jo shāka rnam gsum sogs sangs rgyas dngos mtshungs kyi sku rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang gzhan yang nyan thos mchog zung gi snam sbyar/ lhung bzed/ yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel sogs mngon sum dang lkog gyur gyi bzhugs tshul du ma'i sgo nas bod khams kyi bstan 'gro'i srog shing phan bde'i rtsa lag 'phral yun gyi bde ster dpag tu med pas byur por btams pa'i bka' drin dang ngo mtshar ni bskal brgyar brjod kyang rdzogs mtha' ga la mchis/ mthar dam pa'i chos kyi sgo phyes te skal ba mchog dman bar ba gang la gang 'tshams pa'i mdo rgyud man ngag sgrub thabs zhal gdams lung byang dang bcas pa ji snyed bstsal nas ma 'ongs rjes 'jug gi gdul

481)bya'i don du zab mo'i gter du yang sbas zhing*/ 'ga' zhig rgyal rgyud phyi ma'i don la dgongs pa dkor mdzod kyi phyag sbal du bzhag pa sogs/ mdor na de lta bu'i ngo mtshar mchog gi mdzad pa thams cad rgyal po nyid 'phags pa'i ngo bor dngos su bzhugs pa'i 'khor du 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar sngon gyi rgya bal gyi btsun mo'i tshul dang*/ 'jam dbyangs dang phyag rdor ni chos blon thon mi dang 'gar gyi mtshan bzung ba sogs sprul ba'i gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs su byon pa'i mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyi mdzad pa kho nas bzhag pa yin gyi/ bar chad dang log sgrub sogs kyi dri ma rdul phra rab tsam gyis kyang ma gos pa'i 'di gcig pu'i ya mtshan la bsam kyang dad pa'i 'dab brgya bzhad par gor ma chags pa dang*/ de lta bu'i mdzad bzang gis dam pa chos 492)kyi srol rgya cher btod de/ mtha' mar gzugs sku'i snang brnyan bsdu ba'i dus la babs pa'i tshe yang zhal chems rnams dbon sras la bzhag ste/ btsun mo rnams gnyis pad dkar dang ut+pa la'i rnam par gyur pa dang rgyal po nyid kyi sku lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa dbyer med du 'dres te yab yum gsum ga jo bo bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs kar thim pa'i ngo mtshar bstan pa sogs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas las lhag pa'i rnam thar ya mtshan gyi gter du gyur pa ni 'phags pa nyid bod kyi gdul bya la lhag par brtse ba'i bka' drin mdzad tshul yin la/ de lta bu'i chos rgyal sprul pa'i sku de nyid kyi gsung gi gsang ba zab mo'i chos sgor phal mo ches ni 'jam dbyangs thon mi lo tsās zangs kyi byang bu dang chu dar sngon po la sogs la yi ger btab/ rgyal po nyid kyis rab tu gnas te phyag rgyas btab nas 493)lha sa'i gtsug lag khang sogs gter gnas mang por sbas pa rnams snga phyi rim can du gter bton so so la bka' babs lung bstan ji ltar byung ba dang mthun par gter gnas spyan drangs te sems can gyi don mdzad tshul ni chos sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po de nyid kyi bka'i lung byang las/

gdung rabs lnga 'das pa na nga'i ming la khri dang lde btags pa'i rgyal po zhig 'byung ba des sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par byed do/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa khri srong lde btsan gyis rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nas bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho dang*/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug slob dpon rin chen pad+ma 'byung gnas 494)spyan drangs te/ bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzug pa kho na'i ched du smon lam btab nas sku 'khrungs pa'i mkhan slob chos gsum 'dzom zhing bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang sogs sku gsung thugs rten rgya cher bzhengs pa dang*/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i paṇa chen mang po dang bod kyi lo tsā brgya dang rtsa brgyad rnams kyis bka' mdo rgyud man ngag bstan bcos grangs med pa bsgyur nas bshad grwa sngags grwa sgom grwa'i sde tshogs kyis bod khams bkang zhing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad pa'i dus der/ lha sa'i gtsug lag khang du jo bo bcu gcig zhal dang sprul pa'i chos rgyal tha mi dad pa'i slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la gdams pa nyid kyi bka' gtad nas ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i sems can gyi don du zab mo'i gter du bzhugs par gyis shig pa'i zhal gdams gtad rgya nan chags gnang ba ltar/ slob dpon gyis kyang rgyal 495)po'i gsung bzhin chos bka' rtsa ba yan lag ma bu cha lag tshang bar shog ser la bkod nas phyag rgyas btab pa dang*/ bram ze skye ba bdun pa'i sku sha'i ril bu la gu ru nyid kyis maṇi'i sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dam rdzas 'chi med kyi tshe chu bum chung dang bcas pa rnams lhan cig tu/ dbus ri nag po'i mar sna shar phyogs kong yul gyi sa'i lte ba/ bod srin mo gan rgyal 'dra ba'i gru mo gnon phyir sprul pa'i chos rgyal nyid kyi bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag bu chu lha khang du grags par jo bo bcu gcig zhal gyi sku brnyan gyi drung du gtams nas/

myang ban ting 'dzin bzang po'i smon lam gyi mthu las sprul pa'i skyes chen gyis 'thon te dus mtha'i 'gro ba ngan song gi gting rdo rnams 'dren nus par bden stobs kyi mtshams sbyor bar mdzad pa'i mthu byin gyis/ gter gton 496)gyi rgyal po o rgyan las 'phro gling pas me mo glang lo dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes bcu'i dus chen la bu chu'i gtsug lag khang nas gdan drangs te/ spu bo'i rma sku lung gi gnas sgor shog ser nas zhal gdams bshus shing*/ lung nas bstan pa'i chos bdag skyes chen rnams kyis thog drangs pa'i skal ldan rnams smin grol gyi lam la bkod pa dang*/ dam rdzas tshe chu dang bcas pas kyang dus ngan gyi skye 'gro las nyon gyi rgya mtsho gting mtha' med par bying ba rnams thar pa'i skam sar thon pa'i sku drin brjod las 'das par gyur pa 'di thams cad 'phags mchog thugs rje'i bdag po nyid kyi byin rlabs 'ba' zhig ste/ de bas na 'o skol kha ba can gyi sems can rnams kyi lha'i skal ba ni yi dam thugs rje chen po/ chos kyi skal ba ni yang snying yi ge drug pa kho na lhag par byin rlabs myur zhing 'grub sla ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir na 497)rgyal ba'i thugs rje la che chung bzang ngan sogs yod pa ma yin yang gdul bya'i gdul skal gang yin de nyid lhag par phan thog che ba ni snod bcud rtags mthun pa'i rten 'brel gyi ngang tshul lam chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ des na skabs 'dir yang ji skad du/ chos rnams thams cad rkyen yin te// 'dun pa'i rtse la rab tu gnas/ zhes pa nyid yin pas na 'dun pa dang snang ba dag dgos pas/ bdag rdo rje'i slob dpon la 'phags pa thugs rjai chen pau'i sku'i bkod pa'i sgyu 'phrul du mos par mdzod la/ thal mo sbyor zhing dad gus kyi shugs bskyed pa'i ngang nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug par gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/
slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyis pa la thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur du gsol/ 498)

lan gsum gyi mthar slob dpon gyis/ de ltar khyod kyis gsol ba btab pa bzhin bla mas gnang ba nges par thob pa zhig med thabs ma mchis pas des na/ rigs kyi bu khyod thugs rje chen po yi dam bzung bar 'dod pa de legs so/ de lta na dus de ring nas bzung ste skyabs su 'gro zhing sdom pa bzung ba dang byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa rnams med mi rung gi gal po che yin pas na/ de dag zhu ba'i yul ni dkyil 'khor de nyid du 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor sprul ba dang bcas pa bcas pa rnams phyi ltar na dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum gyi ngo bo/ nang ltar na bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum gyi rang bzhin/ gsang ba ltar na chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum gyi thugs rje'i rnam rol yin pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po bla ma rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid yin phyir skyabs gnas 499)kun 'dus lha dang bla ma mchog gi spyan sngar/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can pha ma drin chen 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las sgrol ba kho na don du gnyer bya'i snying por sems kyi mthil phur du 'chang bzhin pas skyabs sems sdom bzung gi cho ga 'di dag bdag gi rjes su zlo ba'i tshul gyis blang bar mdzod cig sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs dang*// slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus tshoda'adi nas bzung nas ni// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas chos dang dkon mchog gsum// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams// gus pas yang dag bzung bar bgyi// so so thar dang byang chub sems// rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sems can kun gyi don sgrub phyir// smon pa'i sems

500)dang 'jug pa'i sems// don dam sems mchog bskyed par bgyi// bde bshegs sku'i rigs mchog dang*// rdo rje rigs dang rin chen rigs// pad+ma'i rigs dang las kyi rigs// rigs 'dus thugs rje chen po yi// dam tshig rjes su bzung bar bgyi// sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*// dbang bskur mchog de bdag la stsol/ zhes lan gsum gyi sdom pa byin pa'i mthar de dag gi don bshad de/ de lta bu brjod byed tshig gi sgo nas khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la sdom pa'i nor ldan du bsgrubs pa yin kyang*/ brjod bya don gyi dngos gzhi la go rtogs ma bskyed na dgos don mi 'grub par tshig gi lam du zad par 'gyur phyir// des na skyabs 'gro la phyi nang gsang gsum yod pa'i phyi'i skyabs 'gro ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dkon mchog gsum la 'khor ba ngan song gi 'jigs pa las skyobs par zhu ba yin la/ nang gi skyabs 501)'gro ni bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la 1$10002501$1000180tshe gcig sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs dngos grub 'phrin las zhu ba dang*/ gsang ba'i skyabs 'gro ni chos longs sprul gsum rang sems dang gnyis med gdod nas lhun gyis grub par ngo shes pa nyid de// de la ni skyabs su 'gro bya 'gro byed tha mi dad pa'i ngo bo rang thog tu rang sa zin par yin phyir/ gong ma gnyis la rgyu'i skyabs 'gro dang phyi ma 'di la 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro'i tha snyad du'ang brjod pa ste/ mdor na 'di lta bu la blo khel nges 'drongs thag chod kyi dam la gnas pa ni skyabs su 'gro ba'i don gyi rtsa ba lags shing*/ sems bskyed la smon 'jug don dam gsum ste/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral bar 'dod pa'i lhag bsam smon pa byang chub kyi sems dang*/ de ltar sgrol 'dod kyi blo tsam la mi 'jog par rang 502)gi lus srog la yang ji mi snyam pa'i snying stobs dang brtson pa'i shugs kyis bla med byang chub bsgrub pa ni 'jug pa sems bskyed/

bdag dang sems can dang byang chub du 'dzin pa'i blo'i ri mo mtha' dag chos kyi dbyings zab mor khyab gdal chen por bcad nas grol bas sems bskyed bya skyed byed kyi ngo bo mi dmigs pa ni don dam pa'i sems bskyed ces bya ba ste/ de ltar sems bskyed gsum yang gong ma gnyis kun rdzob bden pa dang*/ 'og ma ni don dam bden pa ste/ bden gnyis zung 'jug gi ngo bor lam du 'khyer dgos pa lags/ sdom pa gsum la phyi so thar gyi ngo bo ni sgo gsum nyes spyod mtha' dag spong zhing*/ khyad par sems can kun la gnod 'tshe gtan spang dang*/ nang byang sems kyi sdom pa ni/ rang don zhi bde don du mi gnyer bar gzhan don rlabs po che bsgrub pa la skyo ngal 503)rdul tsam med cing de la'ang bdag gis gzhan phan bsgrubs so snyam pa'i ngar 'dzin dang rlom sems med pa dang*/ gsang ba rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa ni/ phyi nang snod bcud bdag gzhan phung khams dbang tshogs sems sogs gang la yang log rtog mtshan 'dzin gyi lhad mi zhug par/ lha sngags chos nyid gsum du ma gyur pa gang yang med pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen por dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du lam du 'khyer bar bya ba ste/ de ltar sdom pa gsum gyi rnam dbye nges tshig mtshan nyid sogs shin tu mang yang don gyi snying po 'di dag tu 'du bas na rgyud la 'dres bar mdzad dgos par lags/ de yan chad kyis khyed cag gi rgyud la dbang gi ye shes skye ba'i yul dang snod du rung bar bsgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim pa yin 504)la/ da ni dbang dngos bskur ba la yang bskur bya'i yul dang bskur byed kyi rdzas gnyis ka lha'i ngo bor gzhi nas grub kyang rnam par gsal gdab dgos phyir/ bdag gis dmigs pa ji ltar sprad pa 'di bzhin yengs med du gsal thob cig khyed rang rnams so so rang rang gi gdan nyid me tog pad+ma dkar po nyid 'dab ma 'bum ldan steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas par mos nas/

de steng khyed rang rnams kyi rig pa'i ngo bo ni hrīḥyig dkar po mdangs ldan 'od zer 'bar ba zhig tu gyur pa las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs 'phros pas rgyal ba'i zhing rab 'byams la mchod pa'i sprin spros/ khams gsum rigs drug gi sems can gyi las sgrib sdug bsngal bsal/ 'od zer slar 'dus nas hrīḥl thim pa tsam gyis hrīḥyig lha skur gnas 'gyur te/ 505) 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs nam mkha'i rgyal po sku mdog gangs la nyi ma shar ba'i mdangs bzhin dkar la 'tsher ba/ zhal bcu gcig las 'og ma gsum dkar zhing mdzes pa/ de'i steng ma gsum ser zhing bzhad pa/ de steng gnyis dmar la khro 'dzum/ de steng gnyis mthing nag khros pa/ de'i rtse mor 'od dpag med pa sprul sku'i zhal dmar ser mdzum mdangs can gyis mtshan par gsal/ rtsa ba'i phyag bcu'i thog ma gnyis thugs kar thal sbyar/ de 'og g.yas g.yon shel phreng pad dkar/ de 'og gnyis 'khor lo spyi blug de 'og gnyis mchog sbyin dang rin chen/ 'og ma gnyis sangs rgyas sprul ba'i sku dang thabs shes kyi mda' gzhu bsnams pa/ de'i yan lag gi phyag sor brgyad kyi g.yas 506)pa bcu dgu pos rim pa ltar rin chen/ zhags pa/ lhung bzed/ ral gri/ rdo rje/ rgya gram/ nor bu/ me shel/ gzhu/ lcugs ma/ rnga yab/ phub/ bum pa/ dgra sta/ 'phreng ba/ pad sngon/ spyi blug nyi ma/ pad dkar rnams dang*/ g.yon gyi bcu dgu pa/ sprin dkar/ spyi blug gser gyi pad+ma/ ral gri/ dung dkar/ thod dbyug 'phreng ba/ dril bu/ rdo rje/ lcags kyu/ mkhar gsil/ sprul pa'i sku gzugs/ gzhung*/ glegs bam/ 'khor lo/ sku gzugs/ shing tog pad+ma dmar po/ rin chen zur brgyad pa rnams 'dzin pa/ nying lag gi phyag stong rtsa gnyis ni mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i mthil na ye shes kyi spyan re res mtshan pa can/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs shing*/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu g.yon bkab pa/

phyag zhabs rnams la sbrul gyis dkris nas rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis 507)mdzes par brgyan zhing dar dmar mthing gi sham thabs dang dar zab kha dog sna tshogs pa'i stod g.yogs ske rags dar dpyangs 'phur ba/ 'ja' 'od lnga ldan gyi klong na sku snang la rang bzhin med pa dwangs shing gsal ba/ mdzes shing brjid pa blta bas mi ngoms pa ye shes 'od kyi skur lam me bar gsal ba'i sku'i spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gis mtshan pa/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po āḥyis mtshan pa/ thugs kar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de'i 'og tu pad dkar 'dab ma drug pa'i lte bar hrīḥdakar po dang 'dab ma rnams la yi ge drug ma'i 'bru re re dang bcas pa gsal bar mdzod/ de ni slob ma'i phung po dam tshig pa'i lhar bskyed cing byin gyis brlab ste/ ma dag mtshan 'dzin gyi bag chags sbyong ba'i thabs zab mo lags pas rtse gcig tu 508)bsgom dgos pas na/ rtog pa gzhan gyi bar ma chod par yengs med rtse gcig pa'i ting 'dzin brtan po gnang 'tshal/ de nas yang dam tshig pa la ye shes pa dbyings nas spyan drangs te bstim zhing rgyas gdab par bya phyir bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer dang khyod rang rnams kyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum hrīḥdang bcas pa rnams las kyang tshad med rnam pa bzhi dang dad pa'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs kyi rgyud bskul nas/ bu gcig gis ma la gdung bas bos pa ltar thugs rje bzod med kyi rlabs g.yos te/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyi 'khor tshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa rnams dbyings nas bya rgod khyu chen lding ba gzan la babs pa bzhin byon nas khyod rang rnams kyi thugs ka'i hrīḥyig la mtsho la kha 509) ba babs pa ltar rgyun mi chad par thim pa'i mos pa rtse gcig tu mdzod la skad cig kyang yengs par ma byed/

ces byas la dri bzang gi spos dang khyad par ye shes 'bebs pa'i rdzas sbyor gyi spos dud dang*/ rol mo sna tshogs dbyangs snyan po dang bcas pas byin 'beb 'di bzhin bya ste/ ༈ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ thugs rje chen po 'dir gshegs shig /mi pham mgon pa 'dir gshegs shig /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'dir gshegs shig /'jig rten dbang phyug 'dir gshegs 1$1000180shig /rje 'gro ba'i skyabs la byon tsa na// sku gsal le gzi brjid ma chung zhig /gsung ma ṇi'i sgra dbyangs ma chung zhig /thugs zhi ba byin rlabs ma chung zhig /rje 'gro ba'i mgon po byon tsam na// dgongs pa mkha' ltar yangs pa la// grwa tshogs kyi skar tshogs shigs se shig /byin rlabs kyi sprin phung thibs se thib// thugs rje 510)yi 'od zer ta la la// nyams kyi 'ja' tshon wa la la// bden pa'i 'brug sgra 'u ru ru// snying rje'i glog dmar khyems se khyem// gzi brjid kyi ser chen sha ra ra// byams pa'i char chen si li li// nga rgyal gyi tha rgod khengs pa la// nyams kyi chu bo brengs se breng*// dug lnga'i me chen 'bar ba yis// sdug bsngal gyi tshal ba nyal la la// kun gzhi yi zhing sa gshin po la// gdams ngag gi sa bon thor ro ro// thos bsam gyi rol nag brengs se breng*// byang chub kyi myu gu rongs se rong*// sku gsum gyi 'bras bu sha ra ra// thugs rje chen po sprul ba'i sku// 'gro ba'i don la thugs rjes gzigs// 'dir byon mos ldan byin gyis rlobs// mos pas rje yi mtshan brjod na// rje 'gro ba'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs// phongs pa rnams la thugs rjes gzigs// sdug bsngal gyi tshad pa bsal du gsol// rgyal ba'i gsung gis bslus 511)pa med// rje yis thugs rjes mi gzigs sam// zhi ba'i thugs rjes 'dir gshegs shig bde bshegs dgongs pa'i byin rlabs kyis// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/

lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra e a ra li hring hring pheṃ pheṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ ka ya wāk+ka cit+ta sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ zhes nan tan du byin dbab cing me tog 'thor la brtan par rgyas 'debs bya ba ni gal po che'o/ de nas dbang rnams kyi dang por bum dbang zhu ba'i don du slob ma'i maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i mjug thog tu bla mas gtso bum gdan drangs la/ kyai skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams nyon zhig da ni dbang bskur gyi rim pa dngos la thog mar lus smin par bya phyir bum pa'i dbang bskur ba yin pas na dmigs pa 'di bzhin bsgom 'tshal te/ bum pa la rigs gsum yod pa'i mtshon byed rtags kyi bum pa ni lus dbang rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor/ 512)mtshon bya don gyi bum pa ni sems nyid thig le nyag gcig yin la/ skabs 'dir ni mtshon pa brda'i bum pa ste/ brda gang mtshon na sku gsum yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor mtshon pa yin te/ de yang bum pa zlum por byung ba ni chos sku spros dang bral ba'i brda dang*/ bum rgyan sna tshogs ldan pa ni longs sku mtshan dpe rdzogs pa dang*/ bum chu rdzas dang bcas pa ni sprul sku 'gro don mdzad par mtshon pa yin te*/ de lta bu'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa 'di nyid 'phags pa thugs rje'i bdag po spyan ras gzigs kyi lha tshogs ma lus pa'i pho brang du lhun gyis grub pa'i byin rlabs kyi za ma tog tu gyur pa 'di khyod cag rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag pa tsam gyis/ lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa khyod kyi tshangs bug tu zhugs nas lus thams cad mer gyis gang zhing*/ las dang nyon mongs kyi 513)sgrib pa mtha' dag sbyang zhing 'phags pa'i sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med du gyur pa'i mos pa dang nges shes rgyud la bsten par zhu/ hrīḥ bkra shis bum pa lha yi gzhal yas khang*// thugs rje chen po lha tshogs bzhugs pa'i gnas// gnyis su med pa byang chub sems kyi chus// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// lus ngag yid gsum bag chags sgrib byang nas// lha'i sku gsung thugs su 'grub par shog

oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ ka ya wak+ka cit+ta āḥ zhes rol mo 'dzab dbyangs dang bcas pa'i rten 'brel gyid sgo thabs du mas slob ma'i snang ba 'gyur nus par byas te spyi bor bskur zhing*/ slob ma la dmigs pa sprad pa dang mthun par slob dpon gyis kyang ting 'dzin gtod pa shin tu gces so/ ༈ de nas gtso bo'i sku rten 'thogs la/ de nas dkyil 'khor gtso mchog thugs rje chen po'i sku las rang 'dra'i sku zhig byon te khyod rang rnams kyi lus la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod 514)cig hrīḥ bde bshegs 'dus pa lha yi dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// rigs 'dus thugs rje chen po yis// sku gsung thugs kyi dbang thob shog oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ma hā ka ru ṇi ka kā ya a bhi ṣi'añtsa maṃ/ zhes spyi gtsug tu bskur zhing me tog 'thor la/ spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i sku// sangs rgyas kun 'dus dbang mchog 'di// deng 'dir khyod la bskur ba yis// thugs rje mchog gi bkra shis shog de ltar lha dbang lus la bskur nas tha mal gyi lus ngag yid gsum dag nas/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs su 'grub pa'i nges shes mdzod cig

de nas thun mong rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur phyir slar yang bum pa thogs te/ de nas khams gsum 'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa bcad nas dug lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bor grol bar bya phyir/ ngo bo thugs rje chen po nyid rang bzhin rgyal ba rigs lnga po rnam pa dbang rdzas lnga'i dbang bskur ba la 515)mos bdun rtse gcig mdzad par 'tshal/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yis chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dpral ba'i steng du bzhag nas dbang bskur zhing bum chu 'thung dang khrus byar gzhug la me tog 'thor te/ rdo rje rigs kyi dbang bskur bas// zhe sdang rnam par dag pa yis// me long ye shes dbang thob nas// thogs pa med pa'i bkra shis shog /de ltar bum pa'i dbang bskur bas kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnas su dag nas me long lta bu'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ dbang rtags su sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa dpral ba'i steng du bzhugs par sgom mdzod cig de nas dbu rgyan rigs lnga'i rna ltag g.yas pa'i steng du dbang bskur la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ rat+na 516)mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣīñtsa maṃ/ me tog 'thor zhing*/ hūm̐/ rin chen rigs kyi dbang bskur bas// nga rgyal rnam par dag pa yi// mnyam nyid ye shes dbang thob nas// yon tan mchog gi bkra shis shog rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur bas/ nyon yid rnam shes gnas su dag nas/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes/ bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan rna ba g.yas pa'i steng du bzhugs par sgom mdzod/ de nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa ldan pa'i steng du dbang bskur la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ badz+ra sa twa a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ me tog 'thor zhing*/ hūm̐/ pad+ma rigs kyi dbang bskur bas// 'dod chags rnam par dag pa yi// sor rtogs ye shes dbang thob nas// shes rab mchog gi bkra shis shog

rdo rjes dbang bskur bas yid kyi rnam shes gnas su dag nas/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas ltag pa'i steng du bzhugs par sgom mdzod cig 1$1000180de nas 517) dril bu rna ltag g.yon gyi steng du dbang bskur la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hum̐/ dharma badz+ra a bhi ṣī ñtsa āḥ me tog 'thor zhing*/ hūm̐/ las kyi rigs kyi dbang bskur bas// phrag dog rnam par dag pa yi// bya grub ye shes dbang thob nas// phrin las 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog dril bus dbang bskur bas sgo lnga'i rnam shes gnas su dag nas/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ sangs rgyas don yod grub pa rna ltag g.yon gyi steng du bzhugs par bsgom mdzod/ de nas me tog cod paṇa spyi bo'i gtsug tu bzhag ste dbang bskur la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ bud+dha na ma a bhi ṣīñtsa maṃ/ me tog 'thor zhing*/ thugs rje dbang phyug ces pa'i gsang mtshan btags nas*/ hūm̐/ bde bshegs rigs kyi dbang bskur bas// gti mug rnam par dag pa yi// chos dbyings ye shes dbang thob nas// ting 'dzin mchog gi bkra shis shog cod paṇa ming gi dbang thob nas ming gzhi'i rnam shes gnas su dag 518)nas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes/ sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad spyi bor bzhugs par sgom mdzod/ dbang de rnams kyi dgos pa dang phan yon ni/ ma rig pa lnga gnas su dag nas rig pa'i ye shes 1$1000250lnga gnas su dag nas rig pa'i ye shes lnga mngon du byed cing dbang thob pa'i rtags rgyal ba rigs lnga rigs bdag tu bkod pas na/ rig pa'i dbang lnga zhes bya ba yin te/ de ltar bum dbang gis lus smin pas lus sgrib dag cing lus lhar bsgom pa la dbang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ de nas gsang dbang ni/ me long gi sin+du ra bdud rtsi ril bu dang bcas pa thogs nas/

de nas mtshon byed brda'i gsang dbang thabs shes byang chub sems kyi rdzas mchog bdud rtsi'i ril bus khyod rang rnams kyi lus kyi gnas bzhir reg cing lce thog tu byin pa la brten nas/ thob bya'i don gyi dbang ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku'i gnas bzhi 519)nas 'od 'phros khyod kyi gnas bzhir phog pas/ rtsa 'dab 'khor lo bzhi byin gyis brlab cing rgyal ba'i sku bzhi 'grub pa'i sa bon rgyud la thebs pa'i mos pa mdzod cig hūm̐/ byang sems dkar dmar thabs dang shes rab kyi// bcud chen bdud rtsi'i ro mchog bde ba skyed// yab yum gnyis med snyoms 'jug byang sems 'di// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// ljags la bdud rtsi'i ro mchog myong gyur nas// lus ngag yid kyi bde ba skye bar shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ bho dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha a bhi ṣi'añtsa āḥ ces brjod de bla mas theb srin gyis ril bu re blangs la slob ma re re bzhin gyi spyi mgrin snying lte bar dbang bskur nas ril bu zar phagacug la/ de lta bu ril bu'i ro zhim par myong ba ni bde ba/ zhim zhing bde ba'i tshor ba 520)'gag med kyi rang bzhin ni gsal ba/ gsal zhing tshor mkhan dngos po a 'thas su ma grub pa'i ngo bo mi rtog pa/ bde gsal mi rtog gsum yang rig thog tu dbyer med pas na zung 'jug gi ye shes te/ de ltar ngo shes par mdzod cig des zab mo gsang ba'i dbang thob pa'i ngag smin/ ngag sgrib dag cing sngags bzlas pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob par 'gyur ba lags/ shes rab yeshes kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ kā pa la bdud rtsis gang ba thogs la/ de nas yid smin par byed pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la brda dang thabs kyi rim pa ji snyed yod na'ang*/ skabs 'dir ni dkyil 'khor lha tshogs yab yum mnyam sbyor gyi bde ba'i ye shes bdud rtsi'i tshul du khyod rang rnams kyi rgyud la bstim pas lhan skyes kyi bde ba nyams su myong bar byed pa yin pas de ltar nges

521)shes bskyed mdzod/ hūm̐/ thabs shes dbyer med bde ba'i bcud// phyag rgya bzhi ldan chos kyi dbyings// dga' bzhi'i ye shes khyad par che// zag med bde chen dbang thob shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ bo dhi tsit+ta pradz+nya dz+nyā na a bhi ṣīñtsa āḥ zhes thod pa snying gar gtug cing bdud rtsi hub gsum 'thung du bzhug go/ de ltar dbang bskur zhing bdud rtsi khong du btungs pa la brten nas rtsa khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i rang bzhin du ye nas lhun gyis grub par bzhugs pa rnams phyag rgya bzhi ldan gyis snyom 'jug mdzad pa'i byang chub kyi sems 'khor lo bzhir rim gyis babs dga' ba bzhi lugs 'byung lugs zlog spel mar myong ba'i thabs kyi rten 'brel lags/ de ltar shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gis yid smin pas/ nyon mongs 522)pa'i sgrib pa dag cing thabs lam zab mo sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu bde ba chen po'i sku thob par byed pa'o/ de nas cho ga spyi babs kyi 'gros ltar na/ 'dir dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che bskur dgos mod kyang*/ gzhung 'di nyid kyi dgongs don la/ bar 'dir lha dbang lus la bskur ba/ sngags dbang ngag la bskur ba gnyis bstan nas/ de rjes chos dbang sems la bskur ba ni bzhi pa'i dbang du mdzad pas na/ dang po lha dbang kyang mdor bsdu ba'i lugs ltar na gtso bo'i sku rten gyi dbang gong du bum pa'i mtha' rten la sogs ba des kyang 'thus rung 'dir rgyas par gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs su bskur ba'i tshul rnams ston pa yin la/ de la'ang phyi nang gsang sgrub tha dad kyi sger dbang du byed na de ka'i gtso 'khor khol phyungs byas chog mod kyi/ skabs 'dir thams cad tshang mar bskur lugs su bkod pa yin pas na/ thog mar gtso mchog gi sku thogs nas 'di skad brjod do/ de nas yang gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa'i sgo nas tshe 453)gcig byang chub sgrub par byed pa la sgo gsum dkyil 'khor sum ldan gyi ngang nas bsgrub dgos/

de ltar sgrub pa'i sngon du lus lha ru byin gyis rlob pa lha sku phyag rgya'i dbang*/ ngag sngags su byin gyis rlobs pa snying po bzlas lung gi dbang*/ yid chos nyid du byin gyis rlabs pa rig pa rtsal gyi dbang rnams thob dgos phyir/ thog mar lha sku phyag rgya'i dbang la brda don nidakyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams so so'i sku las rang 'dra'i sku 'phros te/ khyod rang so so la thim pa tsam gyis phung khams skye mched thams cad 'phags pa thugs rje'i bdag po gtso 'khor gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i nges shes bskyed mdzod cig hrīḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la// lha mchog gtso bos dbang bskur bas// nyon mongs bag chags dngos 'dzin bral// ye shes rdo rje'i sku thob shog oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ 524)a bhi ṣī ñtsa hūm̐/ zhes phyi sgrub kyi sku gtso bo'i spyi bor bzhag cing bstim la dbang bskur te/ 'di dang mtshungs par nang dang gsang ba sogs kyi lha dbang khol phyungs byed pa'i tshe na'ang gtso bo'i bskur tshig 'dis bya'o/ de nas 'khor gyi sku rten rnams kyis kyang rim pa bzhin brjod tshig dang mthun par bskur bar bya ste/ hrīḥ rgyal yum yi ge drug ma mkha' dbyings ltar// sras mchog nor bu 'dzin pa rig mdangs 'od// sras mo rigs sngags 'dzin pa stong gsal che// sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas rigs 'dus gtso// yab yum sras dang bcas pa'i dbang thob shog oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ bud+dha dharma saṅgha ya bo dhi a bhi ṣī ñtsa hūm̐/ hrīḥ dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtso bo rigs drug pha// lha tshogs kun gyi gtso mo rigs drug ma// rgyal ba rigs drug yab yum sku bskyod la// khams gsum rgyud drug bag chags sdug bsngal sbyang*/ rigs kun mnyam nyid 525) rdo rje'i sku thob shog oṃm ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ tram̐ hrī āḥhūm̐/ mum̐ lām̐ mām̐ pyam̐ tām̐hūm̐ sarba a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/

hrīḥ don dam sems la 'khor 'das gnyis med kyang*// ma rtogs dbang gis chags sdang gzung 'dzin byung*// ma rig dug lnga'i rigs drug 'khyams pa la// bcom ldan thub drug byin rlabs dus la babs// sdug bsngal lam drug bsdam pa'i dbang thob shog oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ kre/ braṃ/ kruṃ/ k+ṣaṃ/ sruṃ/ ye sarba na ra ga te ye a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ hrīḥ thog med dus nas byang chub sems bskyed de// tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs dgongs pa mthar phyin pas// 'gro ba'i don mdzad yang nas yang du byon// dus gsum sems can las dbang 'khyams pa la// bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsa'i dbang thob shog oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ sarba bud+dha a 256)bhi ṣī ñtsa hūm̐/ hrīḥ bdag gzhan ma rig nyon mongs bar chad bsal// brtul zhugs nus pa'i dag snang dngos grub ster// lus dang grib ma bzhin du skyob mdzad pa'i// dpal mgon pho rgyud mo rgyud srung ma'i tshogs/ dad ldan bu yi bar chad zhi bar mdzod// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ de nas nang sgrub kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi dbang la gtso bo rtsa phyag brgyad pa'i sku rten gyi bskur tshig ni gong ma ltar bya ba ni/ bsdu na gtso 'khor lhan cig pa'i tshig 'dir yang tshang bas na rim pa bzhin bskur bar bya ste/ hrīḥ dkyil 'khor ma lus rigs 'dus spyan ras gzigs// 'jam dbyangs mi g.yo sgrol ma dzam bha la// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i byin rlabs thugs rje ni// bdag sogs 'gro la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ sarba dharma a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ hrīḥ 'gro don dus gsum 257)sangs rgyas mar me mdzad// shāka thub byams pa pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// mkhyen brtse nus ldan 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas rnams// mi mngon dbyings nas sgyu mar skur bzhengs la// dus gsum sangs rgyas dbang mchog thob par shog

/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ sarba dharma e kā a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ hrīḥ dkyil 'khor sgo bzhir lcags kyu zhags pa dang*/ lcags sgrog dril bu sgo ma bzhi po ni// rigs drug lam 'gag thar ba'i gnas su 'dren// zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las mnga' mdzad pa'i// sgo ma chen po bzhi yi dbang thob shog dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho a bhi ṣī ñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bskur bar bya'o/ gsang sgrub kyi lha dbang gi gtso bo'i bskur tshig ni gong gi phyi sgrub tu yod pa des bskur zhing*/ 'khor rnams kyis ni/ hrīḥ rnam snang dkar po phyag na shel bum 'dzin// 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe yis rab bkang nas// bu yi spyi bo'i gtsug tu dbang bskur bas// 'gyur med sku'i dngos grub thob par shog oṃ kā ya a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ hrīḥ snang mtha' dmar po byu ru'i bum pa 'dzin// 'chi med rdo rje tshe yi rab bkang nas// bu yi mgrin pa'i gnas su dbang bskur bas// 'gag med gsung gi dngos grub thob par shog oṃ hrī a bhi ṣī ñtsa hūm̐/ hrīḥ mi skyod mthing ga phyag na mthing bum 'dzin// 'chi med rdo rje tshe yis rab bkang nas// bu yi snying ga'i gnas su dbang bskur bas// 'khrul med thugs kyi dngos grub thob par shog oṃ hūm̐ a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ hrīḥ rin 'byung ser po phyag na gser bum 'dzin// 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe yis rab bkang nas// bu yi lte ba'i gnas su dbang bskur bas// yon tan re ba skong ba'i dbang thob shog oṃ traṃ a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ hrīḥ don grub ljang khu phyag na g.yu bum 'dzin// 'chi med rdo rje tshe yis rab bkang nas// bu yi gsang ba'i gnas su dbang bskur bas// phrin las thog pa med pa'i dbang thob shog oṃ āḥ.a bhi ṣi'añtsa hūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.aḥ badz+ra a yu khe hūm̐ nṛ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ hrīḥ ma dag phung po lnga po dag pa'i chu// 'phags pa'i rigs lnga yab yum dbang bskur bas// dug lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bor smin// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyis// deng 'dir bu la dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/

oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma bud+dha ḍa ki ni sidhi swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho a bhi ṣi'añtsa hūm̐/ sngon chad rang sems rang dbang ma thob pas// khams gsum rgyud drug 'khyams shing las 'bras smin// deng 'dir dbang chen 'bar ba rigs bzhi yi/ 530)/sku bzhi ye shes lnga yi rang zer 'phros// 'khor 'das rang dbang 'du ba'i dbang thob shog oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma ta kri ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṝ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ a bhi ṣi'añtsa hūm̐/ hrīḥ sngon chad ma rig dbang gis lus mang blangs// mngal dang sgo nga drod gsher rdzus te skyes// gzung 'dzin las lus sdug bsngal myong bas na// sgo ma bzhi yis thugs rje'i phyag rgya bzhis// de nas skye gnas bzhi po'i sgo chod cig dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho a bhi ṣāñtsa āḥ zhes pa'i lha dbang rnams bskur ba'i mthar/ de ltar phyag rgya lha'i dbang thob pa'i dgos pa ni/ gnas skabs su bar chad 'gal rkyen mtha' dag zhi zhing bsrung ba dang*/ yi dam lha'i skyed sgom gang la yang rang byan tshud nas 'grub sla zhing byin rlabs myur du 'jug par 'gyur la/ mthar thug kyang 531)lus mir snang rung sems yi dam lhar smin te rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin gyi sa thob nas 'gro ba'i don rgya cher spyod par 'gyur ba lags/

de nas sngags dbang ngag la bskur ba la rgyas bsdus gnyis te/ rgyas pa yig 'bru so sor bskur ba dang bsdus pa gcig rdzogs su bskur ba'i lugs gnyis kyi dang po rgyas par bskur tshul ni/ yi ge drug tha dad kyi tsa ka li thogs te/ de nas gsung dbang ngag la bskur bar bya phyir dmigs pa 'di ltar sgom mdzod/ khyod rang rnams 'phags pa thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i thugs kar pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma drug pa lte bar hriḥyig dkar pos mtshan pa gcig gsal ba la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas gzungs sngags rgyal po yi ge drug pa shel gyi kha dog ltar dkar gsal 'od du 'bar ba'i sngags phreng skar mda' chad pa lta bur byung nas khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i 'dab 532)1$10002501$10002501$1000180 drug gi steng du bung ba me tog la babs pa bzhin byon zhing*/ de dag las kyang 'od zer dkar po'i cho 'phrul sa phyogs thamasacad du 'phros pas rgyal ba'i thugs rje byin rlabs nus pa mtha' dag bsdus nas khyod rang rnams la thim/ khams gsum rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la 'od zer phog pa tsam gyis thams cad thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur te/ stong khams thams cad yig drug gi sngags sgras 'ur dir du gyur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags gyur pa'i// dam chos ma lus bsdus pa'i bcud// 'gro ba kun gyi dpal du shar// yi ge drug pa'i dbang zhig bskur// sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bgyi// sangs rgyas thams cad bsdus nas ni// rigs sngags rgyal po'i dbang 'di bskur/ oṃ ni sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin// ser sna med pa'i bcom ldan 'das// sangs rgyas kun 'dus chos kyi sku// dbang bskur byin gyis 533)brlab tu gsol// ma ni bzod pa'i pha rol phyin// khrob med pa'i bcom ldan 'das// bde ba chen po longs spyod rdzogs// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ṇi ni tshul khrims pha rol phyin// nyon mongs skyon bral bcom ldan 'das// sku gsum lhun grub sprul ba'i sku// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// pad ni bsam gtan pha rol phyin// rnam g.yeng med pa'i bcom ldan 'das// shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// me ni brtson 'grus pha rol phyin// le lo med pa'i bcom ldan 'das// mkhyen brtse 'gro ba khyab pa'i gsung*// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// hūm̐ ni shes rab pha rol phyin// phrin las kun 'dus bcom ldan 'das// mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa'i thugs// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// gsung yi ge drug pa rdo rje'i sgra// sangs rgyas kun gyis byin rlabs pas// chos kyi snying po bla na med// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes pa'i 'dzab dbyangs 534) dang bcas pas dbang bskur ro/ ༈ bsdus pa gcig dril du bskur bar 'dod na/ hrīḥ yi ge 'bru drug sprul sku cho 'phrul drug /'gro drug skye sgo gcod cing sgrib pa sbyong*// thugs rje chen po'i yang snying yi ge drug skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// ngag gi sgrib pa bag chags kun byang nas// thugs rje chen po'i gsung dang dbyer med shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes shel 'phreng lag tu gtad nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba bstim pa'i dmigs pa dang ldan pas yig drug lan bdun bzlas su bcug pa ni bzla lung 'bog pa'o/ de nas phan yon bshad pa ni rgyas par spro na chos bka' de nyid nang tshan sprul ba'i chos rgyal gyi rnam thar na bzhugs pa de dag bshad cing*/ bsdu na dbang gzhung nyid kyi 'di bshad do/ oṃ ni ye shes lnga dang ldan// ma ni thugs rje kun la khyab// ṇi yis 'gro ba 'dren par byed// pad kyis sdug bsngal thams cad zhi// me yis sdig sgrib bsreg par byed// hūm̐ gis yon tan thams cad bsdud/ yi ge drug 535)pa'i byin rlabs kyis// khams gsum sems can thams cad ni// thar ba'i lam la 'khod par 'gyur// rgyal ba kun gyi byin rlabs pas// yang snying 'dus pa'i snying po 'di// phan bde kun gyi 'byung gnas yin// dngos grub kun gyi rtsa ba yin// mtho ris bsgrod pa'i skas ka yin// ngan song bkag pa'i sgo mo yin// 'khor ba sgrol ba'i gru rdzing yin// mun pa sel ba'i sgron me yin// 1$10002501$10001801$10002501$1000180dug lnga 'joms pa'i dpa' bo yin// sdig sgrib bsreg pa'i me dpung yin// sdug bsngal bsdungs ba'i tho ba yin// mdo rgyud bstan bcos du ma dang*/ thos bsam sgom gsum thams cad kyi// snying po gcig tu bsdus pa'i bcud// gcig chog rgyal po rin po che// yi ge drug pa 'di zlos shig

de ltar sngags dbang ngag la bskur ba'i dgos pa dang phan 536) yon ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ ngag byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthu nus kyis yi ge drug pa kho nar ma zad bsnyen sgrub 'don zlos gang byed kyang nus pa myur du 'byung ba yin te/ sngags dbang ma thob pas lo gsum du bzlas pa byed pa las sngags kyi rjes gnang bzlas lung thob pas zhag gsum du bzlas pa byin rlabs phan yon lhag par 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang*/ gzhan yang gsang sngags bla med kyi lam du tshul bzhin zhugs pa'i gang zag la ni nyin zhag phru gcig gi dbugs nyi khri chig stong drug brgya thams cad yig drug rdo rje'i bzlas par 'gro ba yod de/ de yang dbugs nang du rngub pa ni oṃ dang ma/ khong du gnas pa ni ṇi dang pad/ phyir dbyung ba ni me dang hūm̐ du rang shugs kyis 'grub pa yin la/ de ltar yin tshul rang ngo ma shes na bzlas par mi 'gro zhing*/ ngo shes shing lhag bsam dang ting 'dzin gyis zin na dbugs kyi grangs mnyam bzlas pa rgyun mi chad du 'gro ba yang gsang sngags zab mo'i smin grol gyi chos lags pas de ltar rgyud la sbyor 'tshal lo/ ༈ de nas rig pa rtsal gyi dbang bskur brda don sprad pa ni/ chos dbyug sba dkar tshig gsum pa thogs nas/ de ltar lha dbang lus dang sngags dbang ngag la bskur nas/ da ni chos dbang sems la bskur zhing sems nyid sangs rgyas su ngo sprod par byed pa tshig dbang rin po che rig pa rtsal gyi dbang mchog bskur ba la ni mtshan ma rdzas kyi dbang la rag ma lus mod kyi/ rang sems gnyug ma'i brda dang rtags su mtshon pa'i chos dbyug sba dkar tshigs gsum la brten nas dbang don ngo sprod pa yin te/ de yang chos nyid byang chub sems kyi rtags su kha dog dkar 538)po/ ma bcos rang byung ba'i rtags gcig pur skyes pa/ sku gsum rang shar gyi rtags su tshigs pa gsum dang ldan pa ste/ dpe 'di ci lta bar rang gi sems gdod nas rnam par dag cing 'pho 'gyur med pa/

sus kyang ma byas shing rang byung ba/ sku gsum ye shes lnga sogs sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad rang chas su tshang zhing rdzogs pa yin te/ de nyid gang yin na da lta'i shes pa rjen pa bcos slad ma byas pa'i rang ngo 'di nyid yin te/ 'di nyid rang ngo shes par gyis shig 'di'i rang ngo rig ma rig gi khyad par las 'khor 'das so mtshams gyes pa yin no/ sems nyid rang dbang thob pa las gzhan pa'i dbang bskur du med de/ bskur du med pa'i dbang mchog 'di ni rig pa rtsal gyi dbang dam pa yin pas ngo shes par mdzod cig ces brjod cing chos dbyug slob ma'i snying khar gtad la/ rang byung chos sku skye ba med pa las/ 539)/sna tshogs 'char ba rig pa'i rtsal yin te/ dbang po tshogs drug yul drug dbyings na gsal// nyon mongs drug ni sku drug ye shes drug /rang shar rang grol chos nyid rol pa'i ngang*// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// rig pa rtsal gyi dbang mchog thob par shog oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ tsit+ta a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐ kye/ rigs kyi bu rnams ma g.yengs par nyon cig sems nyid byang chub sems kyi ngo bo la nyon mongs pa drug spang du med de/ ye shes drug dang sku drug rang byung du shar zhing rang byung du grol ba yin no/ 'di ltar dbang thams cad kyi mes po rig pa rtsal gyi dbang thob pas ni dbang thams cad dus gcig la thob pa yin no/ dbang yang dag pa de gang la bya zhe na/ de yang sangs rgyas dang sems can ni rig ma rig las byung ste/ ma rig na 'khor ba dang ngan song yin zhing*/ rig na 540)sangs rgyas yin phyir/ rang rig pa byang chub kyi sems ni nang rtogs na nang sangs rgya/ nub rtogs na nub sangs rgya ba'i byang chub kyi sems 'di nyid kyi rang ngo la ni sangs rgyas pa ltar snang yang sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid kyang ma grub ste/ bde sdug ji ltar snang yang byang chub kyi sems thig le nyag gcig la bri ba dang gang ba med do/

'o na de lta bu'i dbang de slob dpon gang gis slob ma gang la bskur na/ bla ma rang sems sangs rgyas su rtogs pa gcig gis slob ma ye shes kyi cha la gtogs pa la bskur te/ snang srid thams cad byang chub kyi sems thig le nyag gcig gi gzugs brnyan rang byung gi dkyil 'khor yin te/ de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor mthong bar 'dod pa ni gdong g.yogs grol ba yin no/ rang rig byang chub sems kyi sems thig le nyag gcig stong gsal chen po mthong ba ni mig 541)phye ba'o/ rang rig pa chos kyi skur yid ches pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mjal ba'o/ de'i ngang las rang sems chos kyi sku las mi 'gyur ba ni dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'o/ rang rig chos skur bstan pa thob cing mngon du gyur pa ni dbang dang dngos grub thob pa yin no/ de ni chos dbang sems la bskur ba ste/ tshig dbang rin po che don gyi snying po'o/ rig pa rtsal gyi zhes bya ba ni/ dbang gi mthar thug 'di nyid thob pa'i phan yon dgos ched ni/ lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa'i dri ma dang shes sgrib dag pas 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob/ lam gyi mchog phyag rgya chen po sgom pa'i ska ba can du gyur ba lags/ de nas mtha' rten rjes gnang gi dbang bskur ba ni/ slob ma gzhan don nus pa lta bu la ni gdan khri bshams pa'i khar pad zla'i gdan dar ras dkar po sogs la bris pa gting ba'i steng du slob ma bzhag slob ma phal pa la yang pad zla'i gdan mos pa tsam dang*/ steng nas gdug phub/ lag tu 'khor lo dang spyi blug gtad cing dung dkar 'bud du bcug nas rjes su gdams pa 'di ltar brjod par bya ste/ skal ldan gyi bu mchog khyod rnams la 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du bcug zhing bzhi rdzogs kyi dbang bskur ma lus yongs su rdzogs pa bgyis pa grub pa'i mtha' rten gtad rgya rjes gnang gi byin rlabs kyis mnga' gsol ba la yang gnyis las/

rang don rjes su gnang ba ni/ rigs kyi bu khyod rnams kyis dus da nas bzung ste mthar thug bla med byang chub ma thob kyi bar dus nam du'ang*/ lus lha'i dkyil 'khor ngag sngags kyi dkyil 'khor sems chos nyid kyi rol pa dang skad cig kyang ma bral ba la 'bad par gyis shig des ni tshe 'dir rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang 'grub nges pa yin no/ gzhan don rjes su gnang ba 543)ni/ deng nas bzung ste khyod rnams kyis rang nyid zhi bde 'dod pa'am/ gnas skabs tshe 'di'i khe grags lo 'dod sogs tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i bsam sbyor phra mos kyang ma bslad par/ lus dang srog gi ched du yang dka' ba khyad du gsad de ris med kyi 'gro ba bsdu ba rnam pa bzhis phan bde rgya cher sgrub pa ni 'phags pa'i phrin las yin pas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po ches dus 'da' bar byos shig khyab bdag chen po rin chen gdug /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal skyob par gyis// chos kyi dung ni bla med mchog /dri med kunatu gang bar gyis// 'khor lo bsgyur ba stobs po che// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// snying rje chen po blo yi mchog /bdud rtsi chu rgyun dbab par gyis// dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes// nyon mongs kun gyis ma gos kyis// ji srid 'khor 544)ba ma stongs bar// sems can don kun sgrub par gyis/ rdo rje 'dzin pa slob dpon gyi dbang dam pa thob par 'gyur cig ces bskur zhing me tog 'thor/ chos bka' yongs rdzogs kyi glegs bam na bzas dril ba lag tu gtad la/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i chos 'di mkha' mnyam sems can gyi don du blo stobs bskyed nas sgrubs shig shod cig ston cig 'gro ba'i don rgya chen por gyis shig ces bka' gtad dang smon lam gyi dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po'i rab gnas dang bcas pa bya'o/

slar yang gzhung nyid nas gsungs pa'i dbang don ngo sprod 'di yang 'chad par spro na/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i bu rnams legs par nyon zhig de yang sangs rgyas ces bya ba nyes pa mtha' dag rdzogs pa ste/ de lta bu zhig ma thob bar du gnas gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal/ grogs su dang 'grogs kyang sdug bsngal/ las ci la spyod kyang sdug bsngal 545)ma gtogs bde ba'i go skabs med par 'khrul ba lu gu rgyud du gnas/ de ltar gnas skabs su yang tshe srog la bshol ma 'debs mkhan ni med/ 'chi ba'i rkyen ni mang*/ gson pa'i rkyen ni nyung*/ las phal cher ni sdig sgrib ma gtogs dam pa'i chos su 'gro ba ni dka' bas/ de lta bu'i tshul la yang bsam nas dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ bla ma la dbang gi don du gsol ba 'debs dgos so/ de ltar yang phyi bum pa'i dbang gis lus smin pa dang*/ gsang ba'i dbang gis ngag smin pa dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyis yid smin par byas/ phyi lha dbang lus la bskur bas lus lha ru byin gyis brlabs/ nang sngags dbang ngag la bskur bas ngag sngags su byin gyis rlabs/ gsang ba rig pa rtsal gyi dbang sems la bskur bas nyon mongs ye shes su ngo sprod 546)pa'o/ de las dang po bum pa'i chus lus 'khrud pa'i dbang gi don ni/ ma rig pa dri ma lta bu de dang rig pa chu lta bus bkru pa'o/ gsang dbang gi don ni/ chang kha ru myong bas rang sems me lta bu la bde drod rtsol bas rlung gis 'bud pa lta bu'o/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la dpe me long bstan zhing*/ don ni rang shes rig pa'i a ma de rang la 'bral med yod kyang ngo ma shes pa ngo sprad pas gsal stong ma bu 'phrod pa'o/ lha dbang lus la bskur ba yang snod bcud a 'thas kyi zhen pa dag nas/ sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad lta bu snang stong du ngo sprod pa'o/ sngags dbang ngag la bskur ba yang grags stong bsam brjod dang bral ba/

sgra skye 'gag gnas gsum ma grub pa brjod bya'i don rjod byed kyi tshig dbyer med du ngo sprod pa'o/ chos dbang sems la bskur ba'i don yang bsgom bya sgom byed 547)las 'das pa dmigs med mtha' bral du ngo sprod pa'o/ tshig dbang rin po che zhes pa'i don yang rtsol med a ti khyab gdal chen po dbang bskur bya skur byed thams cad tshig tsam du zad pa'i phyir ro/ tha snyad rnam grangs bstan pa ni/ dkyil 'khor 'di yang brda tsam srid pa'i chags tshul bstan pa'o/ lha'i bskyed rim rnams kyang tha mal du zhen pa las bzlog phyir lus grub tshul ltar bshad pa tsam mo/ spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol mchod bstod rnams kyang med bzhin shar ba sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor lta bur bstan pa'o/ sngags bzla ba yang bdag gzhan gyi brjod tshig thams cad la bden rdzun dang snyan mi snyan du ma grub pa la a 'thas kyi mngon zhen zlog byed tsam du'o/ dran pa'i nges shes gsal gdab pa yang ma grub bzhin du gnyis snang gi 'dzin pa bshig pa'i phyir te/ 548)rang 'od rang la gnas pa ni/ dper na nyi ma dang 'od/ tsan+dan dang dri/ chu dang chab rom/ brag dang brag ca lta bu ste/ sems dngasems byung*/ bsgom bya dang sgom byed/ brjod bya dang rjod byed/ blta bya dang lta byed sogs tha dad ma grub pas na/ nyon mongs pa brtul zhing bde ba'i shugs dang ldan pa la brtul zhugs kyi ming tsam du bya'o/ de lta bu'i rang rig gi dkyil 'khor nyid la rang dbang rang gis thob tsa na/ sangs rgyas dang sems can gnyis su ma grub la/ phyogs bcu yang phyogs dang bral ste a ti khyab gdal zhes ming dang tshig tsam du zad pa'i don rtogs pa ste/ dbang thob pa'i mchog ni de lta bu la bya'o/ de ltar ma go na dbang ma thob pa ste/ gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i ngang nas gzhan dbang du shor bas khams gsum du 'khor zhing rigs drug tu 'khyams nas sdug bsngal sna tshogs la spyod cing rang dbang rang gis mi
549)'du ba ni dbang ma thob pa yin no/ rang rig rang ngo shes pa ni dbang thob pa yin pas de lta bu rtogs pa'i thabs la 'bad par mdzod cig

ces ngo sprod gnad bsnun du gdab pa ni dbang gi snying po yin pas/ dpon slob gnyis kas g.yas med gal ma mchis su mi bya bar don lhan du bya'o/ de nas bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rgya cher brjod pas rab tu gnas pa dang*/ slob dpon la sku drin gso zhing*/ dpon slob thams cad kyi dge ba bsngo ba dang*/ lha tshogs rnams la btang rag gi mchod bstod dang tshogs mchod bka' srung la gtor ma 'bul ba sogs rgyas par byas la/ lhag chad kha bskang ba'i bstod gsol bsngo smon shis brjod rdzogs rim la bsdu ba sogs ni las gzhung ltar bya'o// 'di la dbang bsdus par bskur 'dod na/ chos bshad gang mtshams kyi rjes su skyabs sems gsol gdab sdom zung rnams byas la ye shes dbab pa mdor bsdus dang*/ de nas bum pa/ sku rten gtso bo/ gsang dbang*/ sher dbang*/ sngags lung 'bog pa bsdus pa/ rig pa'i rtsal dbang rnams bskur bas chog pas na 550) de ltar dang*/ gal te khrom dbang lta bu byed dgos na bum pa/ gtso bo'i sku/ sngags dbang*/ tshig dbang gi ngo sprod mdor bsdus tsam la bskur rung ba'o/ de ltar 'phags pa thugs rje chen po ngan song rang grol gyi dbang bskur gter gzhung nyid las slar ltas chog sgrigs chags su bgyis pa lo rgyus mtshams sbyor dang bcas pa zhig phyi rabs kyi don du gyis shig ces/ 7 rgyal dbang pad+ma saṃ bha dang mgon po zla 'od gzhon nu tha mi dad pa 'gro ba'i 'dren par slar yang byon pa'i rje btsun mchog gi sprul sku a wa dhu ti pa chen po dpal bzang po rdo rje'i zhal nas bka' stsal ba rjes su sgrub phyir/ spong ba pa rgan po pad+ma legs grub rtsal gyis/ shar gyi shrī pad+ma ri'i ri ngogs mi shig brag gi khang bzang du yi ger bkod pa'i dge bas mkha' khyab 'gro kun ngan song gi sdug bsngal las grol bar gyur cig maṅga lam//
